claims.claim: ICE has arrested more than 8,500 children in Donald Trump's second term, and more than twice as many through July as in the same period last year.
claims.episode_span: arrested more than twice as many children as in the same period last year, and more than 8,500 so far
claims.source_title: ‘Chaos and cruelty’: the kids trapped in Trump’s immigration enforcement campaign
claims.supporting_quote: Thus far in Donald Trump ’s second term, ICE has arrested more than 8,500 children .

claims.claim: Many of those children were detained in hotels and office hold rooms where lawyers and family could not find them.
claims.episode_span: Many were held in hotels and in hold rooms in office buildings, where lawyers and family members could not find them.
claims.source_title: ‘Chaos and cruelty’: the kids trapped in Trump’s immigration enforcement campaign
claims.supporting_quote: Many of those children have been detained in locations where lawyers and family members couldn’t find them, such as hotels and hold rooms in office buildings.

claims.claim: Elora Mukherjee said many of her clients were arrested while complying with immigration court instructions, and she has represented more than 100 children and parents in ICE detention in the last year.
claims.episode_span: Elora Mukherjee, a Columbia Law School professor who has represented more than 100 children and parents
claims.source_title: ‘Chaos and cruelty’: the kids trapped in Trump’s immigration enforcement campaign
claims.supporting_quote: Elora Mukherjee, a lawyer and Columbia Law School professor, has represented more than 100 children and parents in ICE detention in the last year and said many of her clients were arrested while complying with immigration court instructions.

claims.claim: The Marshall Project found most immigration violations are civil and that the vast majority of children in the ICE arrest data have no criminal conviction or pending charge beyond the immigration violation.
claims.episode_span: most immigration violations are civil and that the vast majority of children in the arrest data have no criminal conviction
claims.source_title: ‘Chaos and cruelty’: the kids trapped in Trump’s immigration enforcement campaign
claims.supporting_quote: Most immigration violations are civil, not criminal, and the vast majority of children counted in ICE’s arrest data have no criminal conviction or pending charges beyond the immigration violation.

claims.claim: Stephen Miller spoke at an FBI headquarters counterterrorism training just over a week ago, days before prosecutors charged a man over calls and texts to his wife, Katie.
claims.episode_span: Stephen Miller spoke to counterterrorism agents at a training conference at FBI headquarters just over a week ago
claims.source_title: Trump adviser Stephen Miller spoke to agents at recent FBI training on domestic terrorism, sources say
claims.supporting_quote: White House homeland security adviser Stephen Miller spoke at a training conference for counterterrorism agents at FBI headquarters just over a week ago, days before prosecutors criminally charged a man with making disturbing calls and texts to his wife, Katie, multiple sources told CBS News.

claims.claim: Former Justice Department officials called Miller's visit unusual; the White House said it was appropriate to his homeland security role and the domestic-terrorism executive order.
claims.episode_span: Former Justice Department officials called the visit unusual
claims.source_title: Trump adviser Stephen Miller spoke to agents at recent FBI training on domestic terrorism, sources say
claims.supporting_quote: Former Justice Department officials called the visit unusual, given the historical norm of insulating federal criminal investigations from political officials.

claims.claim: Miller told agents the domestic-terrorism initiative was personal because of Charlie Kirk's 2025 assassination and that no threat case is too small.
claims.episode_span: Miller told the agents the initiative was personal, citing the 2025 assassination of Turning Point USA founder Charlie Kirk
claims.source_title: Trump adviser Stephen Miller spoke to agents at recent FBI training on domestic terrorism, sources say
claims.supporting_quote: Miller told the agents that President Trump's initiative to counter domestic terrorism was personal to him, citing the 2025 assassination of his friend, conservative Turning Point USA founder Charlie Kirk, according to a source who was briefed on the meeting and a senior FBI official.

claims.claim: Senate Republican efforts to lower gas and diesel prices before Election Day were derailed by infighting over how to do it.

claims.supporting_quote: Republican efforts to reduce national gas prices in the weeks before Election Day were derailed in the Senate by infighting among GOP lawmakers and members of the administration who could not agree on how to ease consumers’ pain at the pump.
